clue.text: Procedure for holding university meeting

indicators.note: holding means the first piece keeps the second inside it

parts.note: a form is a set procedure or routine

explanation.surface: A rule of order for keeping a university meeting going.
explanation.definitionFit: A forum is a public gathering or assembly for open discussion, so a kind of meeting.

clue.text: Private college breaking up?

definitions.meaning: a private school where young women were taught social graces
a school finishing for the holidays, read as school breaking up

explanation.surface: A private college falling apart.
explanation.definitionFit: A finishing school trains young women in etiquette, and a school finishing is breaking up for holidays.

clue.text: Care — sink contains sticky substance

indicators.note: contains means the answer is held within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Take care: the sink has something gummy in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Resin is a sticky gum exuded by trees.

clue.text: Scatty astronomer — man cut out to be special performer

indicators.note: scatty means scatterbrained, so these letters are jumbled
cut out means the man's letters are removed from the pool

parts.note: Ron is a man's name

explanation.surface: A dizzy astronomer turns out to be a star performer.
explanation.walkthrough: Take RON from ASTRONOMER to leave ASTOMER, then rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A maestro is a distinguished musician or conductor, an outstanding performer.

clue.text: US city wants Indian cooking to a greater extent

parts.note: a balti is a style of Indian curry cooked in a wok-like pan, popular in Britain
more means to a greater extent

explanation.surface: Someone in an American city hankers for more curry.
explanation.walkthrough: A BALTI is a curry style hugely popular in British Indian restaurants, named after the pan it is cooked in.
explanation.definitionFit: Baltimore is a large port city in Maryland in the United States.

clue.text: Physicist is dull speaker to listen to.

indicators.note: to listen to means the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a bore is a tedious speaker

explanation.surface: A scientist who is tedious to hear.
explanation.walkthrough: Niels Bohr was the Danish physicist behind the model of the atom.
explanation.definitionFit: Niels Bohr was a Nobel-winning Danish physicist.

clue.text: High portal's fancy illustration

indicators.note: fancy means elaborated or embellished, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the possessive adds no letter

explanation.surface: An ornate picture over a tall doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: A lithograph is a print made from a stone or metal plate, a kind of picture.

clue.text: Competitors will be on edge, somehow, in such an arena

definitions.text: Competitors will be on edge, somehow, in such an arena

parts.words: Competitors will be on edge, somehow, in such an arena
parts.note: skaters balance on the edges of their blades, so being on edge is literal here

explanation.surface: Nervous athletes in a stadium.
explanation.definitionFit: An ice rink is an arena where skaters compete on the edges of their skates.

clue.text: Lab, too big, compromised vital part of performance?

indicators.note: compromised means damaged, so the letters are disordered

explanation.surface: A big lab dog spoils the show.
explanation.definitionFit: An obbligato is a musical part that must not be omitted, so essential to the performance.

clue.text: Wed in a small market town maybe

definitions.text: Wed in a small market town maybe

parts.words: Wed in a small market town maybe
parts.note: Wed is short for Wednesday, the weekday when many small British towns had shops shut for the afternoon

explanation.surface: A country wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: Early closing day was the weekday when British shops shut at lunchtime, often a Wednesday.

clue.text: I shun nest — out for more spartan accommodation?

indicators.note: out signals that the letters are put out of their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: A bird avoids its nest and looks for tougher lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' is the anagram signal: I SHUN NEST rearranged. The question mark flags that a Nissen hut is only spartan by comparison with a nest.
explanation.definitionFit: A Nissen hut is a corrugated-iron military shelter, basic accommodation for troops.

clue.text: Parliamentarian, deposed leader, showing residual fire

indicators.note: the leader (first letter) of the word is deposed, removed from its place

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament, so a member

explanation.surface: An MP who has unseated the party leader still shows some fire.
explanation.definitionFit: An ember is a glowing remnant of a fire that has died down.

clue.text: State idiot should get into?

indicators.note: the idiot word is to get into, inside, the other piece

parts.note: to state is to say
a nit is a fool, short for nitwit

explanation.surface: A question about what condition a fool ought to aim for.
explanation.walkthrough: 'should get into' puts the idiot inside the verb; read straight, the clue asks what condition a fool ought to reach.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanity is the sound state of mind that a fool, by implication, lacks and should acquire.

clue.text: Bodily well-being and fashion one associated with Paris, say

parts.note: ton is an old word for fashion or high style
I is the Roman numeral one
Paris is an example of a city

explanation.surface: Health and style go together for a Parisian.
explanation.walkthrough: TON as fashion is an old borrowing from French, a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonicity is healthy muscle tone or bodily vigour, a state of physical fitness.

clue.text: Soccer player from home team walked off

parts.note: in means at home
a side is a team
left means walked off or departed

explanation.surface: A footballer quits the home team.
explanation.definitionFit: An inside left was a forward position in old football formations, so a soccer player.

clue.text: Like rook initially unable to escape

definitions.meaning: at the start of a chess game each rook stands ... square
trapped with no way out, as someone cornered

explanation.surface: A chess rook is boxed in from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: A rook begins in a corner square, and being cornered idiomatically means trapped without escape.

clue.text: Graduate repeatedly brought in to reform old university

indicators.note: brought in means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: to alter is to change or reform

indicators.note: repeatedly means the graduate's letters appear twice

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts, a graduate

explanation.surface: A graduate keeps coming back to shake up an old university.
explanation.definitionFit: Alma mater is the university or school one formerly attended.

clue.text: Bird circling round about a village in Africa

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes around the second
circling round means the bird's name is turned to read backwards

parts.note: a lark is a songbird

explanation.surface: A bird wheels over an African settlement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circling round' turns LARK to KRAL, and 'about' puts that round A.
explanation.definitionFit: A kraal is a traditional southern African village of huts, often with a livestock enclosure.

clue.text: Endless gambling makes one : stray

indicators.note: endless means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: gaming is another word for gambling

explanation.surface: Constant betting leads a person astray.
explanation.definitionFit: A gamin is a street urchin, a stray child living rough.

clue.text: Refusal to accept one head, reacting stonily?

indicators.note: to accept means the refusal takes in the next piece

parts.note: no is a refusal
I is the Roman numeral one
bean is slang for head

explanation.surface: Turning down a leader with a stony expression.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth Niobe wept for her slain children until she was turned to stone.
explanation.definitionFit: Niobean means like Niobe, who was turned to stone through grief.

clue.text: Bossy fairy laid into one timid creature, endlessly

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: the fairy is laid into, placed inside, the other pieces
endlessly means the creature's last letter is dropped

parts.note: a mouse is proverbially timid
a peri is a fairy or sprite of Persian myth

explanation.surface: A domineering fairy attacks a nervous little animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' leaves MOUS; 'laid into' looks like an assault in the surface but means placed inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Imperious means domineering and arrogant, giving orders like a bossy person.

clue.text: Substantial plot of land — study extracted mineral

parts.note: real means substantial or actual

indicators.note: extracted means the study is pulled out of the plot

parts.note: a garden is a plot of land
a den is a study or private room

explanation.surface: A mineral dug out from a big plot.
explanation.definitionFit: Realgar is an orange-red arsenic sulphide mineral.

clue.text: Writer with a score to settle?

definitions.text: Writer with a score to settle?

parts.words: Writer with a score to settle?
parts.note: a score here is a piece of written music, and settling it is setting it down

explanation.surface: An author bent on revenge.
explanation.definitionFit: A composer writes musical scores, so is a writer with a score to work out.

clue.text: Element in pollutant giving new vehicle nasty smell at first?

indicators.note: at first means the vehicle and smell come before the other piece

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
BO is body odour

explanation.surface: A new car pumping out a foul smell pollutes the air.
explanation.definitionFit: Carbon is a chemical element found in pollutants such as carbon monoxide and soot.

clue.text: Man offers security hugging small son

indicators.note: hugging means the security embraces the son

parts.note: bail is money given as security for release
S is short for son

explanation.surface: A father offers bail while cuddling his little boy.
explanation.definitionFit: Basil is a common masculine given name, so the clue's 'Man' stands for a particular fellow.

clue.text: Some feel good getting up — no Monday morning feeling?

indicators.note: in a down clue getting up means read upwards, backwards
some means part of the words is taken

explanation.surface: Feeling cheerful getting out of bed, unlike most Mondays.
explanation.definitionFit: Glee is joy, the opposite of the gloom proverbially felt on Monday mornings.

clue.text: Odd way king shifts position

indicators.note: the king's letter changes its position within the word

parts.note: a route is a way
R is the abbreviation for king, from Latin rex

explanation.surface: A monarch oddly changes his route.
explanation.walkthrough: R moves from the front of ROUTE to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Outre means bizarre or unconventional, beyond the bounds of the normal.

clue.text: Expected back to defend record, is European praised?

indicators.note: to defend means the turned piece surrounds and protects the rest
back means the expected word reads backwards

parts.note: due means expected
a log is a record

explanation.surface: A European champion expected to defend a record is praised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns the word for expected into EUD; 'to defend' looks like sport but means wrapping round.
explanation.definitionFit: To eulogise is to praise highly, as in a formal tribute.

clue.text: Glasses provided — abstainer, ere long, goes round drunk

indicators.note: goes round means the rearranged letters surround the abstainer
drunk signals the letters reeling into a new order

parts.note: TT is teetotal, a person who abstains from alcohol

explanation.surface: A teetotaller ends up circling round a drunk, glasses in hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' rearranges ERE LONG to LORGNEE, which 'goes round' TT.
explanation.definitionFit: A lorgnette is a pair of spectacles held up on a handle, a type of glasses.

clue.text: Certainly drug must be avoided for recovery

indicators.note: the drug must be kept out, removed from the word

parts.note: really means certainly
E is ecstasy, a drug

explanation.surface: Getting better certainly means staying off drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: A rally is a recovery, as in health or market prices picking up.
